findings.why: Several raw text parameters can be swapped without the compiler noticing
findings.fix: Wrap each meaning in its own newtype

findings.why: Partial functions and unsafe casts bypass the type system
findings.fix: Handle every case and decode values with real types

findings.why: A very large declaration does too many things to understand or test in one piece
findings.fix: Split the declaration into smaller named parts

findings.why: A disabled warning hides the defect it was written to catch
findings.fix: Remove the flag that disables the warning and fix the code it reports
